prompt.ko: 쉼표를 올바르게 쓴 문장은 어느 것인가요?

what_to_do.en: Tap the sentence with the right commas.

stages.choice_rule: Copy the stem words in every choice. Change commas only: do not add, drop, or swap words. Exactly one choice places commas correctly for one job (three-item list, date, city and state, Yes/No/Well at the start, talking to a name, or no comma). The other three miss a needed comma, add an extra comma, or put a comma after the wrong word. Never write two legal answers. Each choice stays under 60 characters.

gold_items.stem: I see apples grapes and pears.
choices: I see apples, grapes, and pears.
I see apples grapes, and pears.
I see, apples grapes and pears.
I see apples grapes and, pears.

gold_items.stem: Bring a cup plate and spoon.
choices: Bring a cup plate, and spoon.
Bring, a cup plate and spoon.
Bring a cup, plate, and spoon.
Bring a cup, plate and, spoon.

gold_items.stem: <NAME> has a cat and a dog.
choices: <NAME> has a cat, and a dog.
<NAME> has, a cat and a dog.
<NAME> has a, cat and a dog.
<NAME> has a cat and a dog.

roots: Copy the stem words in all four choices. Change only comma placement. Never add, drop, or replace a word.
Exactly one choice is correctly punctuated. Never write two answers that a teacher could both mark right, such as a name at the start and the same name at the end.
Wrong choices miss a needed comma, add an extra comma, or put the comma after the wrong word.
Spread the pool across six jobs: three-item lists, dates, city and state, Yes/No/Well at the start, talking to a name, and no comma needed.
For two things joined by and, the correct choice has no comma. For three or more things, the correct choice uses list commas.
Use <NAME> for any person. Kid world only: school, home, food, pets, play, family, weather. No brands.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four to six words. Easy jobs: a list of three things, Yes or No at the start, or a short line that needs no comma. Wrong choices drop a list comma or stick one in a silly place.
tier_rules.2: Stems of five to seven words. Grade-level jobs: dates, talking to a name, or lists. Distractors move the comma one word over.
tier_rules.3: Near misses. City and state, Well or No at the start, or two things joined by and that should have no comma. Distractors look almost right.

list_comma.en: Use commas to separate three or more things in a list.
list_comma.ko: 세 개 이상의 물건을 나열할 때 쉼표를 씁니다.

date_comma.en: Put a comma between the day and the year in a date.
date_comma.ko: 날짜에서 일과 연도 사이에 쉼표를 넣습니다.

name_comma.en: Put a comma when you talk to someone by name.
name_comma.ko: 이름을 부르며 말할 때 쉼표를 넣습니다.

yes_no_comma.en: Put a comma after Yes, No, or Well at the start.
yes_no_comma.ko: 문장 맨 앞의 Yes, No, Well 뒤에 쉼표를 넣습니다.

city_state_comma.en: Put a comma between a city and a state.
city_state_comma.ko: 도시 이름과 주 이름 사이에 쉼표를 넣습니다.

no_comma.en: Do not put a comma when the sentence does not need one.
no_comma.ko: 쉼표가 필요 없는 문장에는 쉼표를 넣지 않습니다.
